A0193.title: Virtual Economy Regulation Mechanism
A0193.description: Collects virtual asset transaction records, address labels, and fund flow characteristics; applies rule matching, statistical baseline comparison, and anomaly monitoring to identify market manipulation, monopolistic hoarding, and abnormal price fluctuations, and coordinates with anti-monopoly determination and disposal.
A0193.definition: Establish virtual asset transaction regulation and anti-monopoly mechanisms to prevent economic manipulation.
A0193.limitation: Illicit actors can bypass monitoring by using multiple accounts, cross-platform position splitting, and coin mixing to obscure manipulation traces; decentralized exchanges make regulatory rules difficult to enforce. Normal large-scale position building by major holders and price fluctuations of scarce assets are prone to be misidentified as manipulation, and rules lagging behind emerging tactics lead to underreporting.
